title: Multiple qubits and entanglement
outcome: Build a Bell state and explain why one correlation plot alone is not evidence of entanglement.
scope_note: Open to everyone. Review the quick recall if an idea is unfamiliar. Practice completion and understanding evidence are separate.
notation_contract: Operations run left to right. Qubit 0 is the least significant bit: |q1 q0⟩. Probabilities are exact model predictions; counts are samples.
recap: A complex coefficient; probability is its squared magnitude.
H maps 0 to plus and 1 to minus; H twice returns the input.
A basis determines the question; shots repeat preparation.
X uses plus/minus; Y uses plus-i/minus-i.
Combine independent amplitudes by multiplication; this chapter teaches it step by step.

topics.title: Bit ordering and basis labels
topics.objective: Qubit q0 is the least significant bit and top wire.
learning_objectives: Explain why X on q0 produces |01⟩ rather than |10⟩. Extend the rule to three qubits.
topics.teach_markdown: Qubit q0 is the least significant bit and top wire. Two-qubit strings are written |q1 q0⟩. Starting at |00⟩, flipping q0 produces |01⟩ at vector index 1; flipping q1 produces |10⟩ at index 2. For three qubits, |q2 q1 q0⟩=|101⟩ is index 5. The label convention is bookkeeping, not a physical difference between qubits.

topics.title: Tensor products and product states
topics.objective: For q1=(a,b) and q0=(c,d), the joint amplitude vector is (ac,ad,bc,bd).
learning_objectives: For q1=(.6,.8), q0=|+⟩, calculate joint probabilities and the probability q1=1.
topics.teach_markdown: For q1=(a,b) and q0=(c,d), the joint amplitude vector is (ac,ad,bc,bd). Multiply amplitudes first, then square magnitudes for probabilities. For q1=|+⟩ and q0=|1⟩, only 01 and 11 occur equally. Independent product preparations have factorized probabilities for local measurements; four amplitudes do not mean four independently readable classical bits.

topics.title: Controlled gates
topics.objective: CX flips its target when the control is 1, and acts linearly on a superposition.
learning_objectives: Give a concrete input on which CX does not create entanglement and explain its output. Then give an input that does.
topics.teach_markdown: CX flips its target when the control is 1, and acts linearly on a superposition. With q0 controlling q1 it maps 01 to 11 and 11 to 01. A controlled gate does not always produce entanglement: CX leaves |00⟩ and |++⟩ as product states. To make entanglement, both the preparation and operation matter.

topics.title: Bell-state preparation
learning_objectives: Why does a 50/50 chart on 00 and 11 fail to prove entanglement? Describe a different measurement for the Bell-versus-mixture comparison.
topics.teach_markdown: H(q0) on |00⟩ gives (|00⟩+|01⟩)/√2. CX(q0,q1) then gives Φ+=(|00⟩+|11⟩)/√2. Each individual qubit has the mixed reduced state I/2, although the pair is pure. Matching Z results alone is insufficient evidence: a classical mixture of 00 and 11 matches that chart. Compare X statistics to distinguish those two preparations.

topics.title: Joint, marginal, and conditional statistics
topics.objective: A joint chart retains how outcomes occur together.
learning_objectives: Both qubits have 50/50 marginal charts. What information is missing? Compare Bell and independent plus preparations.
topics.teach_markdown: A joint chart retains how outcomes occur together. A marginal sums over the other qubit. For .6|00⟩+.8|11⟩, P00=.36 and P11=.64, so each qubit has P1=.64. Conditional on measuring q0=0, q1=0 with certainty. Identical local 50/50 charts can hide very different correlations. Conditioning on an event of zero probability is undefined.

topics.title: Mixtures versus entanglement
topics.objective: A density matrix describes both pure states and probabilistic mixtures.
learning_objectives: Give a separable state with zero local Bloch vectors. Explain what extra assumption makes local mixedness evidence of entanglement.
topics.teach_markdown: A density matrix describes both pure states and probabilistic mixtures. The mixture ½|00⟩⟨00|+½|11⟩⟨11| has no off-diagonal coherence. Φ+ does. They agree in Z and disagree in X. A zero local Bloch vector means a maximally mixed reduced state, not no state. Local mixedness proves entanglement only when the joint state is known pure; mixed separable states can also have mixed marginals.

topics.title: Teleportation protocol
topics.objective: Alice has unknown input q0 and q1 of a Bell pair; Bob has q2.
learning_objectives: Why does teleportation require classical communication? Explain correction branch 11 and why the input is not copied.
topics.teach_markdown: Alice has unknown input q0 and q1 of a Bell pair; Bob has q2. Alice applies CX(q0,q1), H(q0), then measures q0 into m0 and q1 into m1. Bob applies X if m1=1 and then Z if m0=1. All four branches restore the input state on Bob. The original is consumed, not copied. Bob needs two classical bits; before learning them his reduced state is I/2, so this does not send usable information faster than light.
